details:
ASTRA – Astronaut Health Intelligence System

ASTRA is an AI-powered health-monitoring platform designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. Space missions can make it difficult for astronauts to monitor their well-being and access medical support quickly. ASTRA aims to help address this challenge through a health-monitoring dashboard and a conversational AI assistant.

The platform allows astronauts to view health information and interact with an AI assistant that helps explain available information, identify changes that may need attention, and communicate concerns to mission medical staff. It is designed to support health awareness and decision-making, not to diagnose conditions or replace professional medical care.

ASTRA was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with a web-based interface, Node.js and Express for the backend, and AI integration for its conversational assistant. The project was developed using Visual Studio Code and deployed online through Vercel.

What makes ASTRA creative is its combination of health monitoring and conversational AI in one platform, designed around the unique challenges of space exploration. Our team considered the importance of astronaut safety, accessibility, clear communication, privacy, and the limitations of AI in medical situations.

The intended impact of ASTRA is to support astronaut well-being, make health information easier to understand, and help astronauts communicate potential concerns during long-duration missions. Ultimately, ASTRA explores how AI could contribute to safer and more informed human space exploration.
